summary: Static technical audit of the on-disk working-tree state. scripts/expand-md.js produced byte-identical output to the source (confirmed via diff) -- this file has zero {{prompt:}} markers and zero fenced **Prompt** blocks, so check_prompts.md is structurally N/A end to end. Same for check_platform_and_boundaries.md: the body is pure map/loop consolidation theory with no Claude Code capability assertions to verify, and the maintainer-block references (M4/M5/M6 artefacts, test-strategy skill, THEORY_HANDBOOK_MANIFEST) are internal curriculum cross-references, not platform claims. check_pedagogy.md's technical subset (16, 22, 23, 36, 37) is N/A -- no prompts, no new memory rule authored, no verification machinery built, no context-loading-tier teaching beat. The genuinely checkable surface is check_research_claims.md: three sourced claims in the backing block (Paul David 1990, Brynjolfsson/Rock/Syverson 2021, Shipper & Klaassen/Every 2025 on the 80/20 ratio) all carry [label] + URL + checked/result/due freshness stamp; all three URLs verified alive (200) by curl. The two prior-instance TODOs (Campbell's BVSR and the Wikimedia/Wikipedia control-loop-diagram source lacking clickable URLs) are resolved on this working-tree state -- both now carry a [cultural-vocab] tag in the backing block's Frameworks list, the correct carve-out per check_research_claims.md §1 for public-domain/textbook-foundational concepts, so no outstanding finding there. No skills referenced. No blocking findings, no TODOs.
